---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Guardrail problem
---

## Environment

Component, Guardrail version or commit, OS and architecture, Python or Node version, and MCP client version if applicable.

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected. Provide the shortest reproduction with synthetic inputs and sanitized output.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through [private security reporting](https://github.com/abhi0874/guardrail/security/advisories/new). Keep credentials and private data out of this issue.
